The Crystal Vale stands distinct from the barren desert sands of southern Silithus. It is here that Highlord Demitrian lingers, harboring the secrets of Prince Thunderaan, the Windseeker. Those who gather the severed elemental bindings of the fallen prince and the rarest forged metals are directed to this valley, where the imprisoned lord of air can be coaxed from his bindings and challenged in open battle.
